name: Gon
source:
"I serve Vanessa ’cause I want to, okay?! I always have... and always will!"

Neo-fennec no. 150.

Fearless and reliable, but loyal foremost to Vanessa. Despite Vanessa berating him daily, he seems to be more than okay with it...

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2051100]Steam[/url]]
